summary: Phase 5C Final Features Testing - Sick Leave Recording and Message Notifications. All features working. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Sick leave form validated with all data-testids working correctly. Success screen shows appropriate 'Sick Leave Recorded' message with manager notification and get-better message.

backend_api_tests: POST /api/sick-leave/record - Create sick leave record with symptoms, doctor_note flag
GET /api/sick-leave/my-records - Returns own sick leave records with total_sick_days_this_year
GET /api/sick-leave/all - Manager only access, returns all sick leave records (staff denied 403)
PUT /api/sick-leave/{id}/return-to-work - Mark return to work successfully
Sick leave record with minimal data (only start_date)
PUT /api/leave-requests/{id}/approve - Creates notification AND internal message
PUT /api/leave-requests/{id}/reject - Creates notification AND internal message with rejection reason
PUT /api/day-requests/{id}/approve - Creates notification AND internal message
PUT /api/day-requests/{id}/reject - Creates notification AND internal message with rejection reason
GET /api/messages - Returns internal messages for user
frontend_flows: Request Center shows 5 request types: Leave Request, Report Sick, Request Day Off, Pick Up Shift, Swap Shift
Sick Report form has all fields: sick-start-date, sick-end-date, sick-symptoms, sick-doctor-note, sick-notes, sick-continue-btn
Start Date defaults to today's date
Expected Return date field for end date
Doctor's note checkbox with label 'I will provide a doctor's note (required for 3+ consecutive days)'
Additional Notes field for extra information
Yellow info box: 'Sick leave is recorded immediately. Please also follow your care home's call-in procedure.'
Continue button navigates to confirmation screen
Confirmation screen shows: Request Type, Start Date, Symptoms, Doctor's Note status
Submit Request button with paper plane icon
Success message: 'Your sick leave has been recorded and your manager has been notified.'
What happens next section: 'Focus on getting better. Remember to provide a doctor's note if you're off for 3+ days. You'll receive a message when you return.'
New Request and View My Requests buttons on success screen

seed_data_creation: Multiple sick leave records created during testing with TEST_ prefix. Leave requests and day requests created and approved/rejected to verify internal messages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5C final features complete. Sick Leave Recording feature is fully implemented: POST /api/sick-leave/record creates record in sick_leave collection AND auto-approved leave_request in leave_requests collection. Managers are notified via notification bell. When requests are approved/rejected, both a notification AND internal message are created in the messages collection. GET /api/messages returns messages for the user. Planner validation rules (MIN_REST_HOURS=11, MAX_CONSECUTIVE_DAYS=2) are exposed via GET /api/planner/templates endpoint. All data-testids for sick leave form are implemented correctly as specified.
